paths.path: Emulicious.ini in the Emulicious installation directory, beside Emulicious.jar / Emulicious.exe - portable layout, NOT %APPDATA% and NOT XDG config dirs. All settings (window geometry, System, input, debugger) live in this one ini; any property can be overridden at launch with -set key=value (e.g. -set System=MSX). When the install directory is not writable, recent versions improve rather than redirect this (WhatsNew 2021-01-30: 'Improved support for installing Emulicious into a folder where it doesn't have write access'); the fallback location is not documented.
evidence: docs:SegerEnd/homebrew-tap Formula/emulicious.rb caveats: 'Emulicious writes its settings (Emulicious.ini, savestates) next to its jar'

paths.path: Controller/input configuration lives in Emulicious.ini beside the exe (Setup Keys / Configure Input dialogs write it; 'Restructured setup input dialog' WhatsNew 2019-02-16, 'Added Game Pad support' same release; key presets ship in the install dir under KeyPresets/bgb.ini and KeyPresets/VSCode.ini). The pinned official archive bytecode establishes Java-properties keys: selectors GBGamepad, SMSGamepadA/B, SMSbuttonsGamepad, MSXGamepadA/B; corresponding <selector>Keyboard and <selector>Threshold flags; and Gamepad<N>Key<Action> plus Gamepad<N>Key<Action>_1 (or keyboard Key<Action>/Key<Action>_1). JInput event IDs are component-index*4 with axis/POV direction offsets, -1 means unassigned, and the release allocates action IDs 0..267. KeyPresets ini files use the same Keys* entries.

paths.path: Battery/SRAM saves are .sav files; by default next to the loaded ROM, with an ini/UI option to keep them in a 'sav' folder inside the Emulicious installation directory instead (option added 2023-01-31: 'Added an option to control whether .sav files should be saved next to the roms or not'; the sav folder is referenced by the 2022-12-16 fix 'when sav files were saved to Emulicious's sav folder, they did not always get loaded from there').
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.sav (cartridge RAM dump; Game Boy RTC persists inside the same .sav per the 2024-07-31 fix 'a future timestamp in a .sav file caused the RTC time to change')
evidence: docs:lronaldo/gbtelera WhatsNew.txt 2023-01-31 .sav-next-to-roms option and 2022-12-16 sav-folder fix
docs:emulicious.net / committed all_emulators.csv row corroborates 'ROM directory or sav folder'

paths.path: Savestates are written into an 'sstates' folder inside the Emulicious installation directory. Hotkeys (WhatsNew 2016-12-04 'Savestates'): number keys 1-9 load the corresponding slot, Ctrl+1-9 save into slots, Ctrl+S quicksave, Ctrl+Q quickload; optional auto-load most recent state on ROM open and auto-save current state on exit; optional keep-SRAM-when-loading-state option (2022-12-30). Game Boy states are BESS-interoperable with SameBoy/BGB (2021-04-30).
paths.naming: sstates/<ROM basename>.s<slot> - observed artifacts in repos that bundled Emulicious: sstates/game.sn0, sstates/SpaceChase.sn0, sstates/SpaceChase_GBC.sn0 (quicksave/slot-0 files named .sn0) and sstates/mspacman.S00; exact per-slot extension letters are not documented (closed source), only the sstates/<ROM basename>.s* pattern is observable

paths.path: Optional. Emulicious has built-in BIOS emulation for all systems (e.g. WhatsNew 2019-02-16 'Added BIOS emulation for Game Gear', 2021-01-30 'Fixed initial state of VBK in Emulicious BIOS for GBC'), so no BIOS file is required. External/boot BIOS ROMs can be selected for every supported system (WhatsNew 2017-02-27 'BIOS files for all supported systems can be selected now'); they are placed in / pointed at from the Emulicious install directory via Emulicious.ini keys - observed GB keys in committed ini: GameBoyBootROM=dmg_boot.bin and GameBoyColorBootROM=cgb_boot.bin (GBEmulatorShootout downloads those files next to Emulicious.jar). MSX runs on C-BIOS 0.29 shipped inside the install dir (MSX/cbios_msx1.rom, MSX/cbios_msx2.rom, MSX/cbios_sub.rom, MSX/cbios.txt); SMS/Game Gear BIOS roms and Everdrive OS files are user-supplied.
paths.naming: Built-in BIOS emulation is the default; observed external names are dmg_boot.bin, cgb_boot.bin, MSX/cbios_msx1.rom, MSX/cbios_msx2.rom, MSX/cbios_sub.rom, and MSX/cbios.txt. The closed-source emulator documentation does not publish canonical checksums for these assets.
evidence: docs:lronaldo/gbtelera WhatsNew.txt 2017-02-27 BIOS selection paragraph; 2019-02-16 GG BIOS emulation; 2021-01-30 'Emulicious BIOS for GBC'
